sources.note: Homepage. Positions IMS as AI-powered EHR, practice management, and patient engagement software. Claims 40+ specialties, cloud and mobile, Black Book 2025 winner.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Classified as Complete EHR, Ambulatory. Lists 50 certified criteria, 9 CQMs. Details relied-upon software (Sybase SQL Anywhere, First Databank, Surescripts, Exostar, MicroMedex). Lists additional-cost modules: patient portal, HIE, e-prescribing, patient education, InTouch messaging, patient API, immunization/syndromic/cancer interfaces, FHIR API, lab integration, device integration, IMSGo mobile app.

Specialty EHR page listing 40+ specialties with dedicated sub-pages. Lists key product modules: IMS Care, InTouch, Televisit, IMSGo, OnArrival, Patient Scheduler, Authorization & Referrals, IMS Billing, EMO, and reporting tools (MIPS, HEDIS, UDS).

EHR product page. Details clinical features (charting, CareProtocol CDS, flow charts, chronic care, referral management, patient education), OrderPlus e-prescribing, E&M coding assistance, EPCS, tablet/voice/stylus input, single database for EHR and PM, client-server or cloud deployment.
About page. Founded 1998 by Patel family. 41,000 healthcare professionals, 1,600+ clinics. IPS pharmacy product launched 2003. ISO 9001:2015 certified. Sacramento HQ.

Medical billing page. Billing is integrated into IMS. Clearinghouse: Availity. Features: claims creation/scrubbing/submission/denial management, superbills, payment processing (BillFlash, Global Payments), recurring payments, billing reports.
Patient portal and mobile app. HIPAA-compliant, iOS/Android. Patient capabilities: payments, refill requests, appointment scheduling, document uploads, televisit screen sharing, OTP login.
Vendors and integrations page. Lists preferred vendors: ER Tech Pros, DrCatalyst, DosePacker, Nexus HR, MedVision, Locus Insurance, Technoverge.

Full integration catalog. 30+ direct integrations including labs (Labcorp, Quest, 90+ total), clearinghouses (Availity, Data Dimensions), e-prescribing (Surescripts, First Databank, CoverMyMeds, Exostar), patient engagement (Artera, Brevium, EngagedMD, Solutionreach), payment (Global Payments, Exact Payments, BillFlash), AI (Nabla), medical devices (Clinii, HIMSA, Morgan Scientific, ndd), governance (DHIT, FigMD). Immunization registry interfaces for 16+ states.
MedPharm Services LLC info. HQ in San Juan, PR. Founded by Kalpesh Patel (Meditab co-founder). Provides implementation, support, consulting, remote staffing for healthcare companies.
Market intelligence. IMS holds ~0.01% market share. 54% of users are small practices (<50 employees). 92% US-based. Top industries: Medical Practice (21%), Hospital & Health Care (16%).
Capterra reviews. Ratings 4-5/5. Users describe customizability and all-in-one nature as strengths.
Software Advice (Gartner) profile. Active profile with reviews dating to 2023+.
Editorial review. Overall 4.5/5, ease of use 4.0/5, customer support 3.8/5, value 4.1/5, functionality 3.9/5.
HealthAIDB ratings. Charting/Document Management 9.5/10, Templates 9.4/10, HIPAA Compliance 8.5/10.

Awards page. Black Book Research awards in 2023 (13 wins), 2024 (13 wins), 2025 (9 wins). Categories include allergy, endocrinology, dermatology, gastroenterology, pediatrics, podiatry, urology, and best ambulatory EHR for small practices.
September 2024 press release. Meditab and DrCatalyst jointly acquired Fox Meadows Software (founded 1994), a practice software and RCM vendor.
April 2024 press release. Brevium patient reactivation platform integrated into IMS for allergy/immunotherapy patient workflows.
EMR Systems directory listing. Describes IMS as all-in-one EHR/PM/billing with 40+ specialty modules.
MICA Information Systems — top US Value-Added Reseller for IMS, founded 1979. Provides implementation, support, and billing services.
DrCatalyst — affiliated partner providing virtual medical assistant and remote staffing (1,200+ remote staff). Jointly acquired Fox Meadows Software with Meditab.
All-in-one EHR overview page. Emphasizes single-system approach with EHR, PM, billing, patient engagement, and telemedicine integrated.
FQHC-specific page. Details UDS reporting, sliding fee scale support, multi-service-line support, and population health management for community health centers.
